92	## 1. Reliability Diagram（校准图）
93	
94	**用途**：显示模型 confidence bin vs accuracy，对角线 = 完美校准。
95	
96	```python
97	def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
98	                              label='', color='#0072B2',
99	                              title='Reliability Diagram',
100	                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
101	    """
102	    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
103	    """
104	    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
105	    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []
106	
107	    for i in range(n_bins):
108	        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
109	        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
110	        if mask.sum() > 0:
111	            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
112	            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
113	            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
114	        else:
115	            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
116	            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
117	            bin_counts.append(0)
118	
119	    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
120	    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)
121	
122	    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
123	        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
124	        sharex=True
125	    )
126	
127	    # 主图：gaps
128	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
129	                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
130	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
131	                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
132	    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
133	    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
134	    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
135	    ax_main.set_title(title)
136	    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
137	    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)
138	
139	    # ECE annotation
140	    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
141	                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
142	    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
143	                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
144	                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))
145	
146	    # 直方图（样本密度）
147	    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
148	                color=color, alpha=0.5)
149	    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
150	    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')
151	
152	    plt.tight_layout()
153	    plt.savefig(outpath)
154	    plt.close()
155	    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
156	```

177	## 2. ECE Heatmap（方法 × 数据集 ΔECE）
178	
179	**用途**：Main Results Table 的可视化版本，颜色 = ΔECE（红=恶化，蓝=改善）。
180	
181	```python
182	def plot_ece_heatmap(delta_ece_matrix, methods, datasets,
183	                     title='ΔECE Heatmap (vs FP16)',
184	                     outpath='ece_heatmap.pdf'):
185	    """
186	    delta_ece_matrix: shape (n_methods, n_datasets), 正=ECE 恶化, 负=改善
187	    """
188	    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
189	
190	    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(len(datasets) * 1.2, len(methods) * 0.8 + 1))
191	
192	    # 发散色图（中心=0, 红=恶化, 蓝=改善）
193	    vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(delta_ece_matrix))
194	    norm = mcolors.TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax)
195	    cmap = plt.cm.RdBu_r
196	
197	    im = ax.imshow(delta_ece_matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='auto')
198	
199	    # 数值标注
200	    for i in range(len(methods)):
201	        for j in range(len(datasets)):
202	            val = delta_ece_matrix[i, j]
203	            if not np.isnan(val):
204	                color = 'white' if abs(val) > vmax * 0.6 else 'black'
205	                sign = '+' if val > 0 else ''
206	                ax.text(j, i, f'{sign}{val:.1%}', ha='center', va='center',
207	                        fontsize=9, color=color, fontweight='bold')
208	
209	    ax.set_xticks(range(len(datasets)))
210	    ax.set_yticks(range(len(methods)))
211	    ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, rotation=30, ha='right')
212	    ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
213	    ax.set_title(title)
214	
215	    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
216	    cbar.set_label('ΔECE (quantized − FP16)')
217	    cbar.ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.8)
218	
219	    plt.tight_layout()
220	    plt.savefig(outpath)
221	    plt.close()
222	    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
223	```

373	### Pattern E：Wilson Binomial CI
374	
375	```python
376	def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
377	    if n == 0: return 0, 0
378	    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
379	    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
380	    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
381	    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)
382	
383	# 用法
384	lo, hi = wilson_ci(accuracy, n)
385	ax.errorbar(x, accuracy*100, yerr=[[accuracy*100 - lo*100], [hi*100 - accuracy*100]],
386	            fmt='o', capsize=4, capthick=0.8, elinewidth=0.8,
387	            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0)
388	```

## 1. Reliability Diagram（校准图）

**用途**：显示模型 confidence bin vs accuracy，对角线 = 完美校准。

```python
def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
                              label='', color='#0072B2',
                              title='Reliability Diagram',
                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
    """
    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
    """
    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []

    for i in range(n_bins):
        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
        if mask.sum() > 0:
            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
        else:
            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
            bin_counts.append(0)

    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)

    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
        sharex=True
    )

    # 主图：gaps
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
    ax_main.set_title(title)
    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)

    # ECE annotation
    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

    # 直方图（样本密度）
    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.5)
    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

## 2. ECE Heatmap（方法 × 数据集 ΔECE）

**用途**：Main Results Table 的可视化版本，颜色 = ΔECE（红=恶化，蓝=改善）。

```python
def plot_ece_heatmap(delta_ece_matrix, methods, datasets,
                     title='ΔECE Heatmap (vs FP16)',
                     outpath='ece_heatmap.pdf'):
    """
    delta_ece_matrix: shape (n_methods, n_datasets), 正=ECE 恶化, 负=改善
    """
    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(len(datasets) * 1.2, len(methods) * 0.8 + 1))

    # 发散色图（中心=0, 红=恶化, 蓝=改善）
    vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(delta_ece_matrix))
    norm = mcolors.TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax)
    cmap = plt.cm.RdBu_r

    im = ax.imshow(delta_ece_matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='auto')

    # 数值标注
    for i in range(len(methods)):
        for j in range(len(datasets)):
            val = delta_ece_matrix[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                color = 'white' if abs(val) > vmax * 0.6 else 'black'
                sign = '+' if val > 0 else ''
                ax.text(j, i, f'{sign}{val:.1%}', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=9, color=color, fontweight='bold')

    ax.set_xticks(range(len(datasets)))
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(methods)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, rotation=30, ha='right')
    ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
    ax.set_title(title)

    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
    cbar.set_label('ΔECE (quantized − FP16)')
    cbar.ax.axhline(0, color='k', linewidth=0.8)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

### Pattern E：Wilson Binomial CI

```python
def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
    if n == 0: return 0, 0
    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)

# 用法
lo, hi = wilson_ci(accuracy, n)
ax.errorbar(x, accuracy*100, yerr=[[accuracy*100 - lo*100], [hi*100 - accuracy*100]],
            fmt='o', capsize=4, capthick=0.8, elinewidth=0.8,
            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0)
```

- [ ] 字号 ≥ 10pt（缩到 column width 后仍可读）
- [ ] 无 dual y-axis、无 3D、无 pie
- [ ] Bar chart 从 0 起（line/scatter 可非 0）
- [ ] 文字水平不旋转

### L2 叙事（说服力）
- [ ] 能用一句话写出 figure takeaway（应等于 `narrative_intent`）
- [ ] `design_notes` 中的 pattern 都已实现
- [ ] Subtitle / panel label 是 insight 不是描述
- [ ] 数据质量差异视觉可见（n < 50 用空心 / OOS 用 diamond 等）
- [ ] 颜色绑定语义而非数据顺序（整篇论文一致）

### L3 美观（高级感）
- [ ] 不像 matplotlib gallery 示例（无默认灰背景、无粗网格、无 tab10 色板）
- [ ] 配色 muted 和谐，不刺眼（用 Okabe-Ito 或自定义语义色板）
- [ ] 线宽、字号、间距全图统一
- [ ] 元素对齐严格（bars 底部对齐、labels 水平对齐、panels 顶部对齐）
- [ ] 留白充足（元素之间不拥挤，panels 之间有间距）
- [ ] 与论文其他图的风格一致（配色方案、字号、线宽）
- [ ] Hero Figure（Figure 1 + 主结果图）投入了 ≥5 轮迭代
- [ ] 终极判断：这张图放在 NeurIPS best paper 里违和吗？

脚本 `/tmp/run_random_sweep.sh` 和 `/tmp/run_l2norm_sweep.sh` 均存在且内容正确\\n  - 日志末尾有 `ALL_RANDOM_DONE` 和 `ALL_L2NORM_DONE` sentinel\\n  - 全部 8 个结果 JSON 均已写入 `/root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress/results/`\\n  - 所有 pruned 版本远低于 baseline (26.4%)，token pruning 对 SmolVLA + MetaWorld 伤害极大\\n  - Random: k=0.5 (9.6%) 反而优于 k=0.95 (6.4%)，非单调，可能因 random pruning 引入的随机性\\n  - L2Norm: k=0.9 (10.0%) 是最佳点，但仍仅为 baseline 的 38%\\n  - drawer-open 是最鲁棒的 task（L2Norm k=0.95: 30%），其余 tasks 几乎归零\\n- **修复建议**: 提交 sweep 任务时配置 `log_path` 指向持久化路径（非 /tmp），或在脚本中输出 W&B sentinel，使监控能正确追踪。\\n\\n## 8. π0.5 L2norm vs Random Cliff Zone 分析 (2026-05-25)\\n\\n**核心发现：π0.5 Object suite 上 L2norm 与 Random 存在 crossover，约在 k≈0.75。**\\n\\nL2norm 在高 k（0.85-0.95）完全无损（98-99% vs baseline 98.2%），cliff 在 k=0.85→0.7 之间（42pp 断崖跌落至 56%）。Random 在高 k 极度不稳定（k=0.85 约 0-6%），但低 k 时（0.5-0.7）反而比 L2norm 更稳（68-74% vs 33-56%）。\\n\\n**解释**：Random 均匀采样保留了 token 多样性，低 k 时多样性比 importance 更重要。L2norm 集中保留高 norm token，高 k 时保全了关键信息，但低 k 时丢弃的 token 里可能含不可替代的空间/语义信息，导致崩溃比 Random 更彻底。\\n\\n**论文意义**：这个 crossover 是 importance margin 概念的直接证据——scoring method 的优劣取决于 keep ratio，不存在全局最优 scoring method。\\n\", \"total_chars\": 6442, \"truncated\": false}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {}}"}

## 1. SimplerEnv 概述

**仓库**: [simpler-env/SimplerEnv](https://github.com/simpler-env/SimplerEnv) (CoRL 2024, ICLR 2025)

**核心**：基于 SAPIEN + ManiSkill2 的仿真评估框架，用于评估真实世界机器人操控策略在仿真环境中的表现。

### 支持的 Tasks（9 个预设环境）

**Google Robot（控制频率 3Hz）**：
- Pick Coke Can / Pick Random Object / Move Near
- Open/Close Drawer / Place in Closed Drawer

**WidowX Bridge（控制频率 5Hz）**：
- Spoon on Towel / Carrot on Plate / Stack Cube / Eggplant in Basket

### 支持的 VLA 模型
- RT-1 / RT-1-X（原生支持）
- Octo（原生支持）
- **OpenVLA**（通过 [DelinQu fork](https://github.com/DelinQu/SimplerEnv-OpenVLA) 集成）
- **π0 / π0-FAST**（通过 openpi/lerobot 集成，已有社区支持）
- π0.5：**存在已知问题**（[openpi#799](https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi/issues/799)），SimplerEnv 上性能不稳定

### 评估方式
- **Visual Matching**：将真实图像叠加到仿真背景
- **Variant Aggregation**：多种环境变体（背景、光照、干扰物）取平均

### 版本
- **ManiSkill2（主分支）**：CPU 仿真，9 个 tasks，成熟稳定
- **ManiSkill3 分支**：GPU 加速 10-15x，但只移植了 4 个 Bridge tasks

## 2. 与 LIBERO 的互补性

| 维度 | LIBERO | SimplerEnv |
|------|--------|------------|
| 定位 | 终身学习/知识迁移 | 仿真复现真实策略 |
| Tasks | 130 个，分 4 个 suite | 9 个预设，多变体 |
| 机器人 | Franka Panda (tabletop) | Google Robot + WidowX |
| 观测 | 多相机 (agentview + wrist) | 单相机 (obs_camera) |
| 动作空间 | 7-DoF (delta pos + gripper) | world_vector + rot_axangle + gripper |
| 评估指标 | 成功率 (per-task, per-suite) | 成功率 (visual matching / variant agg) |
| GPU 需求 | 渲染用 EGL | 需 RTX GPU（ray-tracing） |

**互补性**：LIBERO 测试 long-horizon + 多任务泛化，SimplerEnv 测试 sim-to-real 保真度。论文中两个 benchmark 同时报告可以展示方法的全面性。

## 3. 竞品分析（Token Pruning for VLA）

| 方法 | 发表 | SimplerEnv | LIBERO | 核心思路 |
|------|------|-----------|--------|---------|
| **SP-VLA** | arXiv 2506.12723 | ✅ 2.4x加速+6%提升 | ✅ 1.5x无损加速 | 动作感知调度 + 时空token pruning |
| **DTP** | arXiv 2601.16065 | ✅ SIMPLER benchmark | ❓ | 去除task无关区域的干扰token |
| **Compressor-VLA** | arXiv 2511.18950 | ❌ | ✅ 59% FLOPs↓ | 指令引导的视觉token压缩（cross-attn） |
| **LightVLA** | arXiv 2509.12594 | ✅ | ✅ | 可微分token pruning |
| **EfficientVLA** | OpenReview | ✅ | ❓ | Training-free 加速+压缩 |
| **Ours** | - | ❌ 放弃 | ✅ | Importance margin + smart compress |

**关键发现**: SP-VLA 是最直接的竞品。

## 4. Pruning 适配方案

**关键洞察：pruning hook 与环境无关，只需替换 env loop。**

- **OpenVLA 适配（2-3h）**：创建 `OpenVLAPruningPolicy` 实现 SimplerEnv 接口，复用现有 hook 代码
- **π0.5 适配（4-6h）**：需解决多相机→单相机映射，且存在已知稳定性问题
- **建议**：先做 OpenVLA

## 5. 安装与渲染状态（westd-27271）

### 服务器配置

- **SimplerEnv 路径**: `/root/autodl-tmp/SimplerEnv/`

**SAPIEN 2.2.2（ManiSkill2 主分支要求）**：

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Paper figures for Importance Margin VLA Compress.
Reads registry.yaml, produces crossover_heatmap.pdf, disruption_curve.pdf, cv_scatter.pdf.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import yaml
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
REGISTRY_PATH = SCRIPT_DIR.parent / 'registry.yaml'
OUTPUT_DIR = SCRIPT_DIR

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

METHOD_COLORS = {
    'random':    '#E69F00',
    'l2norm':    '#0072B2',
    'attention': '#009E73',
    'baseline':  '#555555',
}
METHOD_LABELS = {
    'random': 'Random', 'l2norm': 'L2-Norm',
    'attention': 'Attention', 'baseline': 'Baseline',
}
SUITE_COLORS = {
    'Object': '#0072B2', 'Goal': '#D55E00',
    'Spatial': '#009E73', 'Long': '#CC79A7',
}
MODEL_COLORS = {
    'OpenVLA': '#D55E00', u'π0.5': '#0072B2',
    'X-VLA': '#009E73', 'SmolVLA': '#CC79A7',
    'OpenVLA-OFT': '#F0E442',
}


# ── Data extraction ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_registry():
    with open(REGISTRY_PATH) as f:
        return yaml.safe_load(f).get('experiments', {})


def normalize_sr(val):
    if val is None:
        return None
    try:
        val = float(val)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return val * 100 if val <= 1.0 else val


def extract_model(eid):
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'oft' in e:
        return 'OpenVLA-OFT'
    if 'openvla' in e:
        return 'OpenVLA'
    if 'pi05' in e:
        return 'π0.5'
    if 'xvla' in e:
        return 'X-VLA'
    if 'smolvla' in e:
        return 'SmolVLA'
    return None


def extract_suite(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = (spec.get('command', '') or '').lower()
    dp = (spec.get('data_path', '') or '').lower()
    e = eid.lower()
    blob = f'{e} {cmd} {dp}'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_object', 'libero-object', '_object_', '_obj_']):
        return 'Object'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_goal', 'libero-goal', '_goal_']):
        return 'Goal'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_spatial', 'libero-spatial', '_spatial_']):
        return 'Spatial'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_10', 'libero-10', '_long_']):
        return 'Long'
    if ('xvla' in e or 'openvla' in e) and re.search(r'(?:prune|pruning)_k\d', e):
        return 'Object'
    return None


def extract_method(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = (spec.get('command', '') or '').lower()
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'baseline' in e or 'prune_mode none' in cmd:
        return 'baseline'
    if any(x in e for x in ['attention', 'attn']) or \
       any(x in cmd for x in ['attention_prune', 'attention_last', 'attention_mean', 'attention_rollout']):
        return 'attention'
    if 'l2norm' in e or 'l2_norm' in cmd or 'l2norm' in cmd:
        return 'l2norm'
    if 'random' in e or 'random_prune' in cmd or '--mode random' in cmd:
        return 'random'
    if re.search(r'(?:prune|pruning)_k\d', e):
        return 'random'
    return None


def extract_k(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = spec.get('command', '') or ''
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'baseline' in e:
        return 1.0
    for pat in [r'keep_ratio\s+([\d.]+)', r'k_ratio\s+([\d.]+)']:
        m = re.search(pat, cmd)
        if m:
            return float(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(r'_k(\d+?)(?:_|$)', e)
    if m:
        digits = m.group(1)
        val = int(digits)
        n = len(digits)
        if n <= 2:
            return val / 10.0
        elif n == 3:
            return val / 100.0
        elif n == 4:
            return val / 1000.0
    return None


def get_sr(exp):
    m = exp.get('metrics', {})
    for f in ['success_rate', 'overall_sr', 'overall_SR', 'overall_success_rate']:
        if f in m:
            return normalize_sr(m[f])
    return None


def version_score(eid):
    e = eid.lower()
    s = 0
    if 'postfix' in e:
        s += 1000
    vm = re.search(r'_v(\d+)', e)
    if vm:
        s += int(vm.group(1)) * 10
    return s


def build_data(exps):
    records = []
    for eid, exp in exps.items():
        if exp.get('conclusion') != 'success':
            continue
        model = extract_model(eid)
        suite = extract_suite(eid, exp)
        method = extract_method(eid, exp)
        k = extract_k(eid, exp)
        sr = get_sr(exp)
        if not all([model, suite, method]) or k is None or sr is None:
            continue
        records.append({
            'model': model, 'suite': suite, 'method': method,
            'k': round(k, 4), 'sr': sr, 'exp_id': eid,
            'vscore': version_score(eid),
        })
    best = {}
    for r in records:
        key = (r['model'], r['suite'], r['method'], r['k'])
        if key not in best or r['vscore'] > best[key]['vscore']:
            best[key] = r
    return list(best.values())


# ── Figure 1: Crossover Heatmap ─────────────────────────────────

def cell_bg(method, sr):
    base = mcolors.to_rgb(METHOD_COLORS[method])
    t = 0.15 + 0.55 * (sr / 100.0)
    return tuple(1 - t * (1 - c) for c in base)


def text_col(bg):
    lum = 0.299 * bg[0] + 0.587 * bg[1] + 0.114 * bg[2]
    return 'white' if lum < 0.55 else '#222222'


def plot_crossover_heatmap(data, outpath):
    models = ['OpenVLA', 'π0.5', 'X-VLA']
    suites = ['Object', 'Goal', 'Spatial', 'Long']
    methods_order = ['random', 'l2norm', 'attention']

    k09 = [r for r in data if abs(r['k'] - 0.9) < 0.01
           and r['method'] != 'baseline' and r['model'] in models]

    cells = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in k09:
        cells[(r['model'], r['suite'])][r['method']] = r['sr']

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 3.8))

    for i, model in enumerate(models):
        for j, suite in enumerate(suites):
            mdata = cells.get((model, suite), {})
            x0, y0 = j - 0.5, i - 0.5

            if not mdata:
                rect = plt.Rectangle((x0, y0), 1, 1,
                                     facecolor='#F0F0F0', edgecolor='white', lw=2)
                ax.add_patch(rect)
                ax.text(j, i, '—', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=14, color='#AAAAAA')
                continue

            best_m = max(mdata, key=mdata.get)
            best_sr = mdata[best_m]
            bg = cell_bg(best_m, best_sr)
            tc = text_col(bg)

            rect = plt.Rectangle((x0, y0), 1, 1,
                                 facecolor=bg, edgecolor='white', lw=2)
            ax.add_patch(rect)

            ax.text(j, i - 0.15, f'{best_sr:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=tc)
            ax.text(j, i + 0.15, METHOD_LABELS[best_m], ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=8, color=tc, alpha=0.85, fontstyle='italic')

            others = {m: s for m, s in mdata.items() if m != best_m}
            if others:
                parts = [f'{METHOD_LABELS[m][:3]}={s:.0f}' for m, s in
                         sorted(others.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])]
                info = '  '.join(parts)
                ax.text(j, i + 0.37, info, ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=5.5, color=tc, alpha=0.6)

    ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(suites) - 0.5)
    ax.set_ylim(len(models) - 0.5, -0.5)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(suites)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(suites, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(models)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(models, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax.tick_params(length=0)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)

    legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=METHOD_COLORS[m],
                                     label=METHOD_LABELS[m], alpha=0.8)
                      for m in methods_order]
    legend_patches.append(mpatches.Patch(facecolor='#F0F0F0',
                                         edgecolor='#CCCCCC', label='No data'))
    ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc='upper left',
              bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1.0), fontsize=9, frameon=False)

    ax.set_title('Best SR at $k{=}0.9$: method crossover across models and suites',
                 fontsize=11.5, pad=12)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Figure 2: π0.5 Disruption Curve ─────────────────────────────

def plot_disruption_curve(data, outpath):
    pi_model = 'π0.5'
    pi_data = [r for r in data if r['model'] == pi_model]

    baselines = {}
    for r in pi_data:
        if r['method'] == 'baseline' and r['k'] == 1.0:
            baselines[r['suite']] = r['sr']

    curves = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in pi_data:
        if r['method'] in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            curves[(r['suite'], r['method'])][r['k']] = r['sr']

    for suite, bl in baselines.items():
        for method in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            curves[(suite, method)][1.0] = bl

    suites_plot = ['Object', 'Goal', 'Spatial', 'Long']
    lstyles = {'random': '-', 'l2norm': '--'}
    markers = {'random': 'o', 'l2norm': 's'}

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 5))

    ax.axvspan(0.85, 0.925, alpha=0.07, color='#D32F2F', zorder=0)
    t = ax.text(0.8875, 3, 'cliff zone', ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=8, color='#B71C1C', alpha=0.45, fontstyle='italic')
    t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

    for suite in suites_plot:
        base_color = SUITE_COLORS[suite]
        for method in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            key = (suite, method)
            if key not in curves or len(curves[key]) < 2:
                continue
            pts = sorted(curves[key].items())
            ks = [p[0] for p in pts]
            srs = [p[1] for p in pts]
            label = f'{suite} {METHOD_LABELS[method]}'
            ax.plot(ks, srs, lstyles[method], color=base_color,
                    marker=markers[method], markersize=4.5, alpha=0.85,
                    label=label, zorder=3)

    r85 = curves.get(('Object', 'random'), {}).get(0.85)
    l85 = curves.get(('Object', 'l2norm'), {}).get(0.85)
    if r85 is not None and l85 is not None:
        c = SUITE_COLORS['Object']
        ax.annotate(f'Random {r85:.1f}%', xy=(0.85, r85),
                    xytext=(0.72, r85 + 15), fontsize=7.5, color=c,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=0.7), zorder=5)
        ax.annotate(f'L2 {l85:.1f}%', xy=(0.85, l85),
                    xytext=(0.72, l85 - 10), fontsize=7.5, color=c,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=0.7), zorder=5)

    r09 = curves.get(('Object', 'random'), {}).get(0.9)
    l09 = curves.get(('Object', 'l2norm'), {}).get(0.9)
    if r09 is not None and l09 is not None:
        gap = l09 - r09
        mid_y = (r09 + l09) / 2
        ax.annotate('', xy=(0.9, r09 + 2), xytext=(0.9, l09 - 2),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#555555', lw=1.0), zorder=4)
        txt = ax.text(0.91, mid_y, f'Δ={gap:.0f}pp', fontsize=7,
                      color='#555555', va='center')
        txt.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

    ax.set_xlabel('Keep Ratio ($k$)', fontsize=12)
    ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
    ax.set_xlim(0.25, 1.03)
    ax.set_ylim(-3, 108)
    ax.set_xticks([0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 0.9, 0.925, 0.95, 1.0])
    ax.set_xticklabels(['0.3', '0.5', '0.7', '0.85', '0.9', '0.925', '0.95', '1.0'],
                       fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

    handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
    order = []
    for s in suites_plot:
        for m in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            lbl = f'{s} {METHOD_LABELS[m]}'
            if lbl in labels:
                order.append(labels.index(lbl))
    ax.legend([handles[i] for i in order], [labels[i] for i in order],
              loc='lower left', fontsize=7.5, ncol=2, framealpha=0.92,
              edgecolor='none', columnspacing=1)

    ax.set_title('π0.5 Disruption Curves: Random vs L2-Norm across suites',
                 fontsize=12, pad=10)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Figure 3: CV Diagnostic Scatter ─────────────────────────────

def plot_cv_scatter(data, exps, outpath):
    cv_known = {
        'π0.5':  0.038,
        'OpenVLA':    0.215,
        'SmolVLA':    0.314,
        'X-VLA':      0.025,
        'OpenVLA-OFT': 0.012,
    }

    for eid, exp in exps.items():
        m = exp.get('metrics', {})
        cv = m.get('importance_cv')
        if cv is None:
            continue
        if 'pi0' in eid.lower():
            cv_known['π0.5'] = cv
        elif 'smolvla' in eid.lower():
            cv_known['SmolVLA'] = cv

    baselines = {}
    worst_k09 = {}
    all_k09 = defaultdict(dict)

    for r in data:
        if r['suite'] != 'Object':
            continue
        model = r['model']
        if r['method'] == 'baseline' or r['k'] == 1.0:
            baselines[model] = max(baselines.get(model, 0), r['sr'])
        if abs(r['k'] - 0.9) < 0.01 and r['method'] != 'baseline':
            all_k09[model][r['method']] = r['sr']
            if model not in worst_k09 or r['sr'] < worst_k09[model]:
                worst_k09[model] = r['sr']

    bl_fallback = {
        'OpenVLA': 74.0, 'π0.5': 98.2, 'X-VLA': 99.2,
        'SmolVLA': 57.2, 'OpenVLA-OFT': 74.0,
    }
    for m, b in bl_fallback.items():
        baselines.setdefault(m, b)

    points = []
    for model in cv_known:
        if model not in baselines or model not in worst_k09:
            continue
        cv = cv_known[model]
        drop = baselines[model] - worst_k09[model]
        points.append((model, cv, drop))

    if not points:
        print('Warning: no data for CV scatter')
        return

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.5))

    ax.axhspan(0, 15, alpha=0.04, color='#4CAF50', zorder=0)
    ax.axhspan(50, 100, alpha=0.04, color='#F44336', zorder=0)
    ax.text(0.01, 7, 'robust', fontsize=8, color='#66BB6A', alpha=0.5,
            fontstyle='italic', va='center')
    ax.text(0.01, 75, 'fragile', fontsize=8, color='#EF5350', alpha=0.5,
            fontstyle='italic', va='center')

    offsets = {
        'π0.5': (10, -14), 'OpenVLA': (10, 8), 'X-VLA': (10, 8),
        'SmolVLA': (-15, 10), 'OpenVLA-OFT': (-15, -15),
    }

    for model, cv, drop in points:
        color = MODEL_COLORS.get(model, '#333333')
        ax.scatter(cv, drop, c=color, s=140, zorder=4,
                   edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.5)
        ox, oy = offsets.get(model, (10, 8))
        arrow = dict(arrowstyle='-', color='gray', lw=0.4) if abs(ox) > 15 or abs(oy) > 15 else None
        ax.annotate(model, (cv, drop), xytext=(ox, oy),
                    textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9.5, color=color,
                    fontweight='bold', arrowprops=arrow)

    ax.set_xlabel('Importance Score CV (coefficient of variation)', fontsize=11)
    ax.set_ylabel('Max SR Drop at $k{=}0.9$ (pp)', fontsize=11)
    ax.set_title('Token Importance CV vs Pruning Sensitivity', fontsize=12, pad=10)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

    cv_vals = [p[1] for p in points]
    drop_vals = [p[2] for p in points]
    ax.set_xlim(-0.02, max(cv_vals) + 0.06)
    ax.set_ylim(min(-5, min(drop_vals) - 5), max(drop_vals) + 12)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    print('Loading registry...')
    exps = load_registry()
    data = build_data(exps)
    n_success = sum(1 for e in exps.values() if e.get('conclusion') == 'success')
    print(f'Parsed {len(data)} unique data points from {n_success} successful experiments')

    plot_crossover_heatmap(data, OUTPUT_DIR / 'crossover_heatmap.pdf')
    plot_disruption_curve(data, OUTPUT_DIR / 'disruption_curve.pdf')
    plot_cv_scatter(data, exps, OUTPUT_DIR / 'cv_scatter.pdf')

    print('\nAll figures saved to:', OUTPUT_DIR)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

OUTPUT_DIR = SCRIPT_DIR

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

METHOD_COLORS = {
    'random':    '#E69F00',
    'l2norm':    '#0072B2',
    'attention': '#009E73',
    'baseline':  '#555555',
}
METHOD_LABELS = {
    'random': 'Random', 'l2norm': 'L2-Norm',
    'attention': 'Attention', 'baseline': 'Baseline',
}
SUITE_COLORS = {
    'Object': '#0072B2', 'Goal': '#D55E00',
    'Spatial': '#009E73', 'Long': '#CC79A7',
}
MODEL_COLORS = {
    'OpenVLA': '#D55E00', u'π0.5': '#0072B2',
    'X-VLA': '#009E73', 'SmolVLA': '#CC79A7',
    'OpenVLA-OFT': '#F0E442',
}


# ── Data extraction ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_registry():
    with open(REGISTRY_PATH) as f:
        return yaml.safe_load(f).get('experiments', {})


def normalize_sr(val):
    if val is None:
        return None
    try:
        val = float(val)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return val * 100 if val <= 1.0 else val


def extract_model(eid):
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'oft' in e:
        return 'OpenVLA-OFT'
    if 'openvla' in e:
        return 'OpenVLA'
    if 'pi05' in e:
        return 'π0.5'
    if 'xvla' in e:
        return 'X-VLA'
    if 'smolvla' in e:
        return 'SmolVLA'
    return None


def extract_suite(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = (spec.get('command', '') or '').lower()
    dp = (spec.get('data_path', '') or '').lower()
    e = eid.lower()
    blob = f'{e} {cmd} {dp}'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_object', 'libero-object', '_object_', '_obj_']):
        return 'Object'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_goal', 'libero-goal', '_goal_']):
        return 'Goal'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_spatial', 'libero-spatial', '_spatial_']):
        return 'Spatial'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_10', 'libero-10', '_long_']):
        return 'Long'
    if ('xvla' in e or 'openvla' in e) and re.search(r'(?:prune|pruning)_k\d', e):
        return 'Object'
    return None


def extract_method(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = (spec.get('command', '') or '').lower()
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'baseline' in e or 'prune_mode none' in cmd:
        return 'baseline'
    if any(x in e for x in ['attention', 'attn']) or \
       any(x in cmd for x in ['attention_prune', 'attention_last', 'attention_mean', 'attention_rollout']):
        return 'attention'
    if 'l2norm' in e or 'l2_norm' in cmd or 'l2norm' in cmd:
        return 'l2norm'
    if 'random' in e or 'random_prune' in cmd or '--mode random' in cmd:
        return 'random'
    if re.search(r'(?:prune|pruning)_k\d', e):
        return 'random'
    return None


def extract_k(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = spec.get('command', '') or ''
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'baseline' in e:
        return 1.0
    for pat in [r'keep_ratio\s+([\d.]+)', r'k_ratio\s+([\d.]+)']:
        m = re.search(pat, cmd)
        if m:
            return float(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(r'_k(\d+?)(?:_|$)', e)
    if m:
        digits = m.group(1)
        val = int(digits)
        n = len(digits)
        if n <= 2:
            return val / 10.0
        elif n == 3:
            return val / 100.0
        elif n == 4:
            return val / 1000.0
    return None


def get_sr(exp):
    m = exp.get('metrics', {})
    for f in ['success_rate', 'overall_sr', 'overall_SR', 'overall_success_rate']:
        if f in m:
            return normalize_sr(m[f])
    return None


def version_score(eid):
    e = eid.lower()
    s = 0
    if 'postfix' in e:
        s += 1000
    vm = re.search(r'_v(\d+)', e)
    if vm:
        s += int(vm.group(1)) * 10
    return s


def build_data(exps):
    records = []
    for eid, exp in exps.items():
        if exp.get('conclusion') != 'success':
            continue
        model = extract_model(eid)
        suite = extract_suite(eid, exp)
        method = extract_method(eid, exp)
        k = extract_k(eid, exp)
        sr = get_sr(exp)
        if not all([model, suite, method]) or k is None or sr is None:
            continue
        records.append({
            'model': model, 'suite': suite, 'method': method,
            'k': round(k, 4), 'sr': sr, 'exp_id': eid,
            'vscore': version_score(eid),
        })
    best = {}
    for r in records:
        key = (r['model'], r['suite'], r['method'], r['k'])
        if key not in best or r['vscore'] > best[key]['vscore']:
            best[key] = r
    return list(best.values())


# ── Figure 1: Crossover Heatmap ─────────────────────────────────

def cell_bg(method, sr):
    base = mcolors.to_rgb(METHOD_COLORS[method])
    t = 0.15 + 0.55 * (sr / 100.0)
    return tuple(1 - t * (1 - c) for c in base)


def text_col(bg):
    lum = 0.299 * bg[0] + 0.587 * bg[1] + 0.114 * bg[2]
    return 'white' if lum < 0.55 else '#222222'


def plot_crossover_heatmap(data, outpath):
    models = ['OpenVLA', 'π0.5', 'X-VLA']
    suites = ['Object', 'Goal', 'Spatial', 'Long']
    methods_order = ['random', 'l2norm', 'attention']

    k09 = [r for r in data if abs(r['k'] - 0.9) < 0.01
           and r['method'] != 'baseline' and r['model'] in models]

    cells = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in k09:
        cells[(r['model'], r['suite'])][r['method']] = r['sr']

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 3.8))

    for i, model in enumerate(models):
        for j, suite in enumerate(suites):
            mdata = cells.get((model, suite), {})
            x0, y0 = j - 0.5, i - 0.5

            if not mdata:
                rect = plt.Rectangle((x0, y0), 1, 1,
                                     facecolor='#F0F0F0', edgecolor='white', lw=2)
                ax.add_patch(rect)
                ax.text(j, i, '—', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=14, color='#AAAAAA')
                continue

            best_m = max(mdata, key=mdata.get)
            best_sr = mdata[best_m]
            bg = cell_bg(best_m, best_sr)
            tc = text_col(bg)

            rect = plt.Rectangle((x0, y0), 1, 1,
                                 facecolor=bg, edgecolor='white', lw=2)
            ax.add_patch(rect)

            ax.text(j, i - 0.15, f'{best_sr:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=tc)
            ax.text(j, i + 0.15, METHOD_LABELS[best_m], ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=8, color=tc, alpha=0.85, fontstyle='italic')

            others = {m: s for m, s in mdata.items() if m != best_m}
            if others:
                parts = [f'{METHOD_LABELS[m][:3]}={s:.0f}' for m, s in
                         sorted(others.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])]
                info = '  '.join(parts)
                ax.text(j, i + 0.37, info, ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=5.5, color=tc, alpha=0.6)

    ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(suites) - 0.5)
    ax.set_ylim(len(models) - 0.5, -0.5)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(suites)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(suites, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(models)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(models, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax.tick_params(length=0)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)

    legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=METHOD_COLORS[m],
                                     label=METHOD_LABELS[m], alpha=0.8)
                      for m in methods_order]
    legend_patches.append(mpatches.Patch(facecolor='#F0F0F0',
                                         edgecolor='#CCCCCC', label='No data'))
    ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc='upper left',
              bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1.0), fontsize=9, frameon=False)

    ax.set_title('Best SR at $k{=}0.9$: method crossover across models and suites',
                 fontsize=11.5, pad=12)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Figure 2: π0.5 Disruption Curve ─────────────────────────────

def plot_disruption_curve(data, outpath):
    pi_model = 'π0.5'
    pi_data = [r for r in data if r['model'] == pi_model]

    baselines = {}
    for r in pi_data:
        if r['method'] == 'baseline' and r['k'] == 1.0:
            baselines[r['suite']] = r['sr']

    curves = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in pi_data:
        if r['method'] in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            curves[(r['suite'], r['method'])][r['k']] = r['sr']

    for suite, bl in baselines.items():
        for method in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            curves[(suite, method)][1.0] = bl

    suites_plot = ['Object', 'Goal', 'Spatial', 'Long']
    lstyles = {'random': '-', 'l2norm': '--'}
    markers = {'random': 'o', 'l2norm': 's'}

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 5))

    ax.axvspan(0.85, 0.925, alpha=0.07, color='#D32F2F', zorder=0)
    t = ax.text(0.8875, 3, 'cliff zone', ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=8, color='#B71C1C', alpha=0.45, fontstyle='italic')
    t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

    for suite in suites_plot:
        base_color = SUITE_COLORS[suite]
        for method in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            key = (suite, method)
            if key not in curves or len(curves[key]) < 2:
                continue
            pts = sorted(curves[key].items())
            ks = [p[0] for p in pts]
            srs = [p[1] for p in pts]
            label = f'{suite} {METHOD_LABELS[method]}'
            ax.plot(ks, srs, lstyles[method], color=base_color,
                    marker=markers[method], markersize=4.5, alpha=0.85,
                    label=label, zorder=3)

    r85 = curves.get(('Object', 'random'), {}).get(0.85)
    l85 = curves.get(('Object', 'l2norm'), {}).get(0.85)
    if r85 is not None and l85 is not None:
        c = SUITE_COLORS['Object']
        ax.annotate(f'Random {r85:.1f}%', xy=(0.85, r85),
                    xytext=(0.72, r85 + 15), fontsize=7.5, color=c,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=0.7), zorder=5)
        ax.annotate(f'L2 {l85:.1f}%', xy=(0.85, l85),
                    xytext=(0.72, l85 - 10), fontsize=7.5, color=c,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=0.7), zorder=5)

    r09 = curves.get(('Object', 'random'), {}).get(0.9)
    l09 = curves.get(('Object', 'l2norm'), {}).get(0.9)
    if r09 is not None and l09 is not None:
        gap = l09 - r09
        mid_y = (r09 + l09) / 2
        ax.annotate('', xy=(0.9, r09 + 2), xytext=(0.9, l09 - 2),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#555555', lw=1.0), zorder=4)
        txt = ax.text(0.91, mid_y, f'Δ={gap:.0f}pp', fontsize=7,
                      color='#555555', va='center')
        txt.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

    ax.set_xlabel('Keep Ratio ($k$)', fontsize=12)
    ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
    ax.set_xlim(0.25, 1.03)
    ax.set_ylim(-3, 108)
    ax.set_xticks([0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 0.9, 0.925, 0.95, 1.0])
    ax.set_xticklabels(['0.3', '0.5', '0.7', '0.85', '0.9', '0.925', '0.95', '1.0'],
                       fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

    handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
    order = []
    for s in suites_plot:
        for m in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            lbl = f'{s} {METHOD_LABELS[m]}'
            if lbl in labels:
                order.append(labels.index(lbl))
    ax.legend([handles[i] for i in order], [labels[i] for i in order],
              loc='lower left', fontsize=7.5, ncol=2, framealpha=0.92,
              edgecolor='none', columnspacing=1)

    ax.set_title('π0.5 Disruption Curves: Random vs L2-Norm across suites',
                 fontsize=12, pad=10)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Figure 3: CV Diagnostic Scatter ─────────────────────────────

def plot_cv_scatter(data, exps, outpath):
    cv_known = {
        'π0.5':  0.038,
        'OpenVLA':    0.215,
        'SmolVLA':    0.314,
        'X-VLA':      0.025,
        'OpenVLA-OFT': 0.012,
    }

    for eid, exp in exps.items():
        m = exp.get('metrics', {})
        cv = m.get('importance_cv')
        if cv is None:
            continue
        if 'pi0' in eid.lower():
            cv_known['π0.5'] = cv
        elif 'smolvla' in eid.lower():
            cv_known['SmolVLA'] = cv

    baselines = {}
    worst_k09 = {}
    all_k09 = defaultdict(dict)

    for r in data:
        if r['suite'] != 'Object':
            continue
        model = r['model']
        if r['method'] == 'baseline' or r['k'] == 1.0:
            baselines[model] = max(baselines.get(model, 0), r['sr'])
        if abs(r['k'] - 0.9) < 0.01 and r['method'] != 'baseline':
            all_k09[model][r['method']] = r['sr']
            if model not in worst_k09 or r['sr'] < worst_k09[model]:
                worst_k09[model] = r['sr']

    bl_fallback = {
        'OpenVLA': 74.0, 'π0.5': 98.2, 'X-VLA': 99.2,
        'SmolVLA': 57.2, 'OpenVLA-OFT': 74.0,
    }
    for m, b in bl_fallback.items():
        baselines.setdefault(m, b)

    points = []
    for model in cv_known:
        if model not in baselines or model not in worst_k09:
            continue
        cv = cv_known[model]
        drop = baselines[model] - worst_k09[model]
        points.append((model, cv, drop))

    if not points:
        print('Warning: no data for CV scatter')
        return

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.5))

    ax.axhspan(0, 15, alpha=0.04, color='#4CAF50', zorder=0)
    ax.axhspan(50, 100, alpha=0.04, color='#F44336', zorder=0)
    ax.text(0.01, 7, 'robust', fontsize=8, color='#66BB6A', alpha=0.5,
            fontstyle='italic', va='center')
    ax.text(0.01, 75, 'fragile', fontsize=8, color='#EF5350', alpha=0.5,
            fontstyle='italic', va='center')

    offsets = {
        'π0.5': (10, -14), 'OpenVLA': (10, 8), 'X-VLA': (10, 8),
        'SmolVLA': (-15, 10), 'OpenVLA-OFT': (-15, -15),
    }

    for model, cv, drop in points:
        color = MODEL_COLORS.get(model, '#333333')
        ax.scatter(cv, drop, c=color, s=140, zorder=4,
                   edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.5)
        ox, oy = offsets.get(model, (10, 8))
        arrow = dict(arrowstyle='-', color='gray', lw=0.4) if abs(ox) > 15 or abs(oy) > 15 else None
        ax.annotate(model, (cv, drop), xytext=(ox, oy),
                    textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9.5, color=color,
                    fontweight='bold', arrowprops=arrow)

    ax.set_xlabel('Importance Score CV (coefficient of variation)', fontsize=11)
    ax.set_ylabel('Max SR Drop at $k{=}0.9$ (pp)', fontsize=11)
    ax.set_title('Token Importance CV vs Pruning Sensitivity', fontsize=12, pad=10)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

    cv_vals = [p[1] for p in points]
    drop_vals = [p[2] for p in points]
    ax.set_xlim(-0.02, max(cv_vals) + 0.06)
    ax.set_ylim(min(-5, min(drop_vals) - 5), max(drop_vals) + 12)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    print('Loading registry...')
    exps = load_registry()
    data = build_data(exps)
    n_success = sum(1 for e in exps.values() if e.get('conclusion') == 'success')
    print(f'Parsed {len(data)} unique data points from {n_success} successful experiments')

    plot_crossover_heatmap(data, OUTPUT_DIR / 'crossover_heatmap.pdf')
    plot_disruption_curve(data, OUTPUT_DIR / 'disruption_curve.pdf')
    plot_cv_scatter(data, exps, OUTPUT_DIR / 'cv_scatter.pdf')

    print('\nAll figures saved to:', OUTPUT_DIR)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Paper figures for Importance Margin VLA Compress.
Reads registry.yaml, produces crossover_heatmap.pdf, disruption_curve.pdf, cv_scatter.pdf.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import yaml
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
REGISTRY_PATH = SCRIPT_DIR.parent / 'registry.yaml'
OUTPUT_DIR = SCRIPT_DIR

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

METHOD_COLORS = {
    'random':    '#E69F00',
    'l2norm':    '#0072B2',
    'attention': '#009E73',
    'baseline':  '#555555',
}
METHOD_LABELS = {
    'random': 'Random', 'l2norm': 'L2-Norm',
    'attention': 'Attention', 'baseline': 'Baseline',
}
SUITE_COLORS = {
    'Object': '#0072B2', 'Goal': '#D55E00',
    'Spatial': '#009E73', 'Long': '#CC79A7',
}
MODEL_COLORS = {
    'OpenVLA': '#D55E00', u'π0.5': '#0072B2',
    'X-VLA': '#009E73', 'SmolVLA': '#CC79A7',
    'OpenVLA-OFT': '#F0E442',
}


# ── Data extraction ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_registry():
    with open(REGISTRY_PATH) as f:
        return yaml.safe_load(f).get('experiments', {})


def normalize_sr(val):
    if val is None:
        return None
    try:
        val = float(val)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return val * 100 if val <= 1.0 else val


def extract_model(eid):
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'oft' in e:
        return 'OpenVLA-OFT'
    if 'openvla' in e:
        return 'OpenVLA'
    if 'pi05' in e:
        return 'π0.5'
    if 'xvla' in e:
        return 'X-VLA'
    if 'smolvla' in e:
        return 'SmolVLA'
    return None


def extract_suite(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = (spec.get('command', '') or '').lower()
    dp = (spec.get('data_path', '') or '').lower()
    e = eid.lower()
    blob = f'{e} {cmd} {dp}'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_object', 'libero-object', '_object_', '_obj_']):
        return 'Object'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_goal', 'libero-goal', '_goal_']):
        return 'Goal'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_spatial', 'libero-spatial', '_spatial_']):
        return 'Spatial'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_10', 'libero-10', '_long_']):
        return 'Long'
    if ('xvla' in e or 'openvla' in e) and re.search(r'(?:prune|pruning)_k\d', e):
        return 'Object'
    return None


def extract_method(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = (spec.get('command', '') or '').lower()
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'baseline' in e or 'prune_mode none' in cmd:
        return 'baseline'
    if any(x in e for x in ['attention', 'attn']) or \
       any(x in cmd for x in ['attention_prune', 'attention_last', 'attention_mean', 'attention_rollout']):
        return 'attention'
    if 'l2norm' in e or 'l2_norm' in cmd or 'l2norm' in cmd:
        return 'l2norm'
    if 'random' in e or 'random_prune' in cmd or '--mode random' in cmd:
        return 'random'
    if re.search(r'(?:prune|pruning)_k\d', e):
        return 'random'
    return None


def extract_k(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = spec.get('command', '') or ''
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'baseline' in e:
        return 1.0
    for pat in [r'keep_ratio\s+([\d.]+)', r'k_ratio\s+([\d.]+)']:
        m = re.search(pat, cmd)
        if m:
            return float(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(r'_k(\d+?)(?:_|$)', e)
    if m:
        digits = m.group(1)
        val = int(digits)
        n = len(digits)
        if n <= 2:
            return val / 10.0
        elif n == 3:
            return val / 100.0
        elif n == 4:
            return val / 1000.0
    return None


def get_sr(exp):
    m = exp.get('metrics', {})
    for f in ['success_rate', 'overall_sr', 'overall_SR', 'overall_success_rate']:
        if f in m:
            return normalize_sr(m[f])
    return None


def version_score(eid):
    e = eid.lower()
    s = 0
    if 'postfix' in e:
        s += 1000
    vm = re.search(r'_v(\d+)', e)
    if vm:
        s += int(vm.group(1)) * 10
    return s


def build_data(exps):
    records = []
    for eid, exp in exps.items():
        if exp.get('conclusion') != 'success':
            continue
        model = extract_model(eid)
        suite = extract_suite(eid, exp)
        method = extract_method(eid, exp)
        k = extract_k(eid, exp)
        sr = get_sr(exp)
        if not all([model, suite, method]) or k is None or sr is None:
            continue
        records.append({
            'model': model, 'suite': suite, 'method': method,
            'k': round(k, 4), 'sr': sr, 'exp_id': eid,
            'vscore': version_score(eid),
        })
    best = {}
    for r in records:
        key = (r['model'], r['suite'], r['method'], r['k'])
        if key not in best or r['vscore'] > best[key]['vscore']:
            best[key] = r
    return list(best.values())


# ── Figure 1: Crossover Heatmap ─────────────────────────────────

def cell_bg(method, sr):
    base = mcolors.to_rgb(METHOD_COLORS[method])
    t = 0.15 + 0.55 * (sr / 100.0)
    return tuple(1 - t * (1 - c) for c in base)


def text_col(bg):
    lum = 0.299 * bg[0] + 0.587 * bg[1] + 0.114 * bg[2]
    return 'white' if lum < 0.55 else '#222222'


def plot_crossover_heatmap(data, outpath):
    models = ['OpenVLA', 'π0.5', 'X-VLA']
    suites = ['Object', 'Goal', 'Spatial', 'Long']
    methods_order = ['random', 'l2norm', 'attention']

    k09 = [r for r in data if abs(r['k'] - 0.9) < 0.01
           and r['method'] != 'baseline' and r['model'] in models]

    cells = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in k09:
        cells[(r['model'], r['suite'])][r['method']] = r['sr']

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 3.8))

    for i, model in enumerate(models):
        for j, suite in enumerate(suites):
            mdata = cells.get((model, suite), {})
            x0, y0 = j - 0.5, i - 0.5

            if not mdata:
                rect = plt.Rectangle((x0, y0), 1, 1,
                                     facecolor='#F0F0F0', edgecolor='white', lw=2)
                ax.add_patch(rect)
                ax.text(j, i, '—', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=14, color='#AAAAAA')
                continue

            best_m = max(mdata, key=mdata.get)
            best_sr = mdata[best_m]
            bg = cell_bg(best_m, best_sr)
            tc = text_col(bg)

            rect = plt.Rectangle((x0, y0), 1, 1,
                                 facecolor=bg, edgecolor='white', lw=2)
            ax.add_patch(rect)

            ax.text(j, i - 0.15, f'{best_sr:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=tc)
            ax.text(j, i + 0.15, METHOD_LABELS[best_m], ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=8, color=tc, alpha=0.85, fontstyle='italic')

            others = {m: s for m, s in mdata.items() if m != best_m}
            if others:
                parts = [f'{METHOD_LABELS[m][:3]}={s:.0f}' for m, s in
                         sorted(others.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])]
                info = '  '.join(parts)
                ax.text(j, i + 0.37, info, ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=5.5, color=tc, alpha=0.6)

    ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(suites) - 0.5)
    ax.set_ylim(len(models) - 0.5, -0.5)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(suites)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(suites, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(models)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(models, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax.tick_params(length=0)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)

    legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=METHOD_COLORS[m],
                                     label=METHOD_LABELS[m], alpha=0.8)
                      for m in methods_order]
    legend_patches.append(mpatches.Patch(facecolor='#F0F0F0',
                                         edgecolor='#CCCCCC', label='No data'))
    ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc='upper left',
              bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1.0), fontsize=9, frameon=False)

    ax.set_title('Best SR at $k{=}0.9$: method crossover across models and suites',
                 fontsize=11.5, pad=12)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Figure 2: π0.5 Disruption Curve ─────────────────────────────

def plot_disruption_curve(data, outpath):
    pi_model = 'π0.5'
    pi_data = [r for r in data if r['model'] == pi_model]

    baselines = {}
    for r in pi_data:
        if r['method'] == 'baseline' and r['k'] == 1.0:
            baselines[r['suite']] = r['sr']

    curves = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in pi_data:
        if r['method'] in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            curves[(r['suite'], r['method'])][r['k']] = r['sr']

    for suite, bl in baselines.items():
        for method in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            curves[(suite, method)][1.0] = bl

    suites_plot = ['Object', 'Goal', 'Spatial', 'Long']
    lstyles = {'random': '-', 'l2norm': '--'}
    markers = {'random': 'o', 'l2norm': 's'}

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 5))

    ax.axvspan(0.85, 0.925, alpha=0.07, color='#D32F2F', zorder=0)
    t = ax.text(0.8875, 3, 'cliff zone', ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=8, color='#B71C1C', alpha=0.45, fontstyle='italic')
    t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

    for suite in suites_plot:
        base_color = SUITE_COLORS[suite]
        for method in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            key = (suite, method)
            if key not in curves or len(curves[key]) < 2:
                continue
            pts = sorted(curves[key].items())
            ks = [p[0] for p in pts]
            srs = [p[1] for p in pts]
            label = f'{suite} {METHOD_LABELS[method]}'
            ax.plot(ks, srs, lstyles[method], color=base_color,
                    marker=markers[method], markersize=4.5, alpha=0.85,
                    label=label, zorder=3)

    r85 = curves.get(('Object', 'random'), {}).get(0.85)
    l85 = curves.get(('Object', 'l2norm'), {}).get(0.85)
    if r85 is not None and l85 is not None:
        c = SUITE_COLORS['Object']
        ax.annotate(f'Random {r85:.1f}%', xy=(0.85, r85),
                    xytext=(0.72, r85 + 15), fontsize=7.5, color=c,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=0.7), zorder=5)
        ax.annotate(f'L2 {l85:.1f}%', xy=(0.85, l85),
                    xytext=(0.72, l85 - 10), fontsize=7.5, color=c,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=0.7), zorder=5)

    r09 = curves.get(('Object', 'random'), {}).get(0.9)
    l09 = curves.get(('Object', 'l2norm'), {}).get(0.9)
    if r09 is not None and l09 is not None:
        gap = l09 - r09
        mid_y = (r09 + l09) / 2
        ax.annotate('', xy=(0.9, r09 + 2), xytext=(0.9, l09 - 2),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#555555', lw=1.0), zorder=4)
        txt = ax.text(0.91, mid_y, f'Δ={gap:.0f}pp', fontsize=7,
                      color='#555555', va='center')
        txt.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

    ax.set_xlabel('Keep Ratio ($k$)', fontsize=12)
    ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
    ax.set_xlim(0.25, 1.03)
    ax.set_ylim(-3, 108)
    ax.set_xticks([0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 0.9, 0.925, 0.95, 1.0])
    ax.set_xticklabels(['0.3', '0.5', '0.7', '0.85', '0.9', '0.925', '0.95', '1.0'],
                       fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

    handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
    order = []
    for s in suites_plot:
        for m in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            lbl = f'{s} {METHOD_LABELS[m]}'
            if lbl in labels:
                order.append(labels.index(lbl))
    ax.legend([handles[i] for i in order], [labels[i] for i in order],
              loc='lower left', fontsize=7.5, ncol=2, framealpha=0.92,
              edgecolor='none', columnspacing=1)

    ax.set_title('π0.5 Disruption Curves: Random vs L2-Norm across suites',
                 fontsize=12, pad=10)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Figure 3: CV Diagnostic Scatter ─────────────────────────────

def plot_cv_scatter(data, exps, outpath):
    cv_known = {
        'π0.5':  0.038,
        'OpenVLA':    0.215,
        'SmolVLA':    0.314,
        'X-VLA':      0.025,
        'OpenVLA-OFT': 0.012,
    }

    for eid, exp in exps.items():
        m = exp.get('metrics', {})
        cv = m.get('importance_cv')
        if cv is None:
            continue
        if 'pi0' in eid.lower():
            cv_known['π0.5'] = cv
        elif 'smolvla' in eid.lower():
            cv_known['SmolVLA'] = cv

    baselines = {}
    worst_k09 = {}
    all_k09 = defaultdict(dict)

    for r in data:
        if r['suite'] != 'Object':
            continue
        model = r['model']
        if r['method'] == 'baseline' or r['k'] == 1.0:
            baselines[model] = max(baselines.get(model, 0), r['sr'])
        if abs(r['k'] - 0.9) < 0.01 and r['method'] != 'baseline':
            all_k09[model][r['method']] = r['sr']
            if model not in worst_k09 or r['sr'] < worst_k09[model]:
                worst_k09[model] = r['sr']

    bl_fallback = {
        'OpenVLA': 74.0, 'π0.5': 98.2, 'X-VLA': 99.2,
        'SmolVLA': 57.2, 'OpenVLA-OFT': 74.0,
    }
    for m, b in bl_fallback.items():
        baselines.setdefault(m, b)

    points = []
    for model in cv_known:
        if model not in baselines or model not in worst_k09:
            continue
        cv = cv_known[model]
        drop = baselines[model] - worst_k09[model]
        points.append((model, cv, drop))

    if not points:
        print('Warning: no data for CV scatter')
        return

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.5))

    ax.axhspan(0, 15, alpha=0.04, color='#4CAF50', zorder=0)
    ax.axhspan(50, 100, alpha=0.04, color='#F44336', zorder=0)
    ax.text(0.01, 7, 'robust', fontsize=8, color='#66BB6A', alpha=0.5,
            fontstyle='italic', va='center')
    ax.text(0.01, 75, 'fragile', fontsize=8, color='#EF5350', alpha=0.5,
            fontstyle='italic', va='center')

    offsets = {
        'π0.5': (10, -14), 'OpenVLA': (10, 8), 'X-VLA': (10, 8),
        'SmolVLA': (-15, 10), 'OpenVLA-OFT': (-15, -15),
    }

    for model, cv, drop in points:
        color = MODEL_COLORS.get(model, '#333333')
        ax.scatter(cv, drop, c=color, s=140, zorder=4,
                   edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.5)
        ox, oy = offsets.get(model, (10, 8))
        arrow = dict(arrowstyle='-', color='gray', lw=0.4) if abs(ox) > 15 or abs(oy) > 15 else None
        ax.annotate(model, (cv, drop), xytext=(ox, oy),
                    textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9.5, color=color,
                    fontweight='bold', arrowprops=arrow)

    ax.set_xlabel('Importance Score CV (coefficient of variation)', fontsize=11)
    ax.set_ylabel('Max SR Drop at $k{=}0.9$ (pp)', fontsize=11)
    ax.set_title('Token Importance CV vs Pruning Sensitivity', fontsize=12, pad=10)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

    cv_vals = [p[1] for p in points]
    drop_vals = [p[2] for p in points]
    ax.set_xlim(-0.02, max(cv_vals) + 0.06)
    ax.set_ylim(min(-5, min(drop_vals) - 5), max(drop_vals) + 12)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    print('Loading registry...')
    exps = load_registry()
    data = build_data(exps)
    n_success = sum(1 for e in exps.values() if e.get('conclusion') == 'success')
    print(f'Parsed {len(data)} unique data points from {n_success} successful experiments')

    plot_crossover_heatmap(data, OUTPUT_DIR / 'crossover_heatmap.pdf')
    plot_disruption_curve(data, OUTPUT_DIR / 'disruption_curve.pdf')
    plot_cv_scatter(data, exps, OUTPUT_DIR / 'cv_scatter.pdf')

    print('\nAll figures saved to:', OUTPUT_DIR)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Paper figures for Importance Margin VLA Compress.
Reads registry.yaml, produces crossover_heatmap.pdf, disruption_curve.pdf, cv_scatter.pdf.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import yaml
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
REGISTRY_PATH = SCRIPT_DIR.parent / 'registry.yaml'
OUTPUT_DIR = SCRIPT_DIR

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

METHOD_COLORS = {
    'random':    '#E69F00',
    'l2norm':    '#0072B2',
    'attention': '#009E73',
    'baseline':  '#555555',
}
METHOD_LABELS = {
    'random': 'Random', 'l2norm': 'L2-Norm',
    'attention': 'Attention', 'baseline': 'Baseline',
}
SUITE_COLORS = {
    'Object': '#0072B2', 'Goal': '#D55E00',
    'Spatial': '#009E73', 'Long': '#CC79A7',
}
MODEL_COLORS = {
    'OpenVLA': '#D55E00', u'π0.5': '#0072B2',
    'X-VLA': '#009E73', 'SmolVLA': '#CC79A7',
    'OpenVLA-OFT': '#F0E442',
}


# ── Data extraction ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_registry():
    with open(REGISTRY_PATH) as f:
        return yaml.safe_load(f).get('experiments', {})


def normalize_sr(val):
    if val is None:
        return None
    try:
        val = float(val)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return val * 100 if val <= 1.0 else val


def extract_model(eid):
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'oft' in e:
        return 'OpenVLA-OFT'
    if 'openvla' in e:
        return 'OpenVLA'
    if 'pi05' in e:
        return 'π0.5'
    if 'xvla' in e:
        return 'X-VLA'
    if 'smolvla' in e:
        return 'SmolVLA'
    return None


def extract_suite(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = (spec.get('command', '') or '').lower()
    dp = (spec.get('data_path', '') or '').lower()
    e = eid.lower()
    blob = f'{e} {cmd} {dp}'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_object', 'libero-object', '_object_', '_obj_']):
        return 'Object'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_goal', 'libero-goal', '_goal_']):
        return 'Goal'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_spatial', 'libero-spatial', '_spatial_']):
        return 'Spatial'
    if any(x in blob for x in ['libero_10', 'libero-10', '_long_']):
        return 'Long'
    if ('xvla' in e or 'openvla' in e) and re.search(r'(?:prune|pruning)_k\d', e):
        return 'Object'
    return None


def extract_method(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = (spec.get('command', '') or '').lower()
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'baseline' in e or 'prune_mode none' in cmd:
        return 'baseline'
    if any(x in e for x in ['attention', 'attn']) or \
       any(x in cmd for x in ['attention_prune', 'attention_last', 'attention_mean', 'attention_rollout']):
        return 'attention'
    if 'l2norm' in e or 'l2_norm' in cmd or 'l2norm' in cmd:
        return 'l2norm'
    if 'random' in e or 'random_prune' in cmd or '--mode random' in cmd:
        return 'random'
    if re.search(r'(?:prune|pruning)_k\d', e):
        return 'random'
    return None


def extract_k(eid, exp):
    spec = exp.get('spec', {})
    cmd = spec.get('command', '') or ''
    e = eid.lower()
    if 'baseline' in e:
        return 1.0
    for pat in [r'keep_ratio\s+([\d.]+)', r'k_ratio\s+([\d.]+)']:
        m = re.search(pat, cmd)
        if m:
            return float(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(r'_k(\d+?)(?:_|$)', e)
    if m:
        digits = m.group(1)
        val = int(digits)
        n = len(digits)
        if n <= 2:
            return val / 10.0
        elif n == 3:
            return val / 100.0
        elif n == 4:
            return val / 1000.0
    return None


def get_sr(exp):
    m = exp.get('metrics', {})
    for f in ['success_rate', 'overall_sr', 'overall_SR', 'overall_success_rate']:
        if f in m:
            return normalize_sr(m[f])
    return None


def version_score(eid):
    e = eid.lower()
    s = 0
    if 'postfix' in e:
        s += 1000
    vm = re.search(r'_v(\d+)', e)
    if vm:
        s += int(vm.group(1)) * 10
    return s


def build_data(exps):
    records = []
    for eid, exp in exps.items():
        if exp.get('conclusion') != 'success':
            continue
        model = extract_model(eid)
        suite = extract_suite(eid, exp)
        method = extract_method(eid, exp)
        k = extract_k(eid, exp)
        sr = get_sr(exp)
        if not all([model, suite, method]) or k is None or sr is None:
            continue
        records.append({
            'model': model, 'suite': suite, 'method': method,
            'k': round(k, 4), 'sr': sr, 'exp_id': eid,
            'vscore': version_score(eid),
        })
    best = {}
    for r in records:
        key = (r['model'], r['suite'], r['method'], r['k'])
        if key not in best or r['vscore'] > best[key]['vscore']:
            best[key] = r
    return list(best.values())


# ── Figure 1: Crossover Heatmap ─────────────────────────────────

def cell_bg(method, sr):
    base = mcolors.to_rgb(METHOD_COLORS[method])
    t = 0.15 + 0.55 * (sr / 100.0)
    return tuple(1 - t * (1 - c) for c in base)


def text_col(bg):
    lum = 0.299 * bg[0] + 0.587 * bg[1] + 0.114 * bg[2]
    return 'white' if lum < 0.55 else '#222222'


def plot_crossover_heatmap(data, outpath):
    models = ['OpenVLA', 'π0.5', 'X-VLA']
    suites = ['Object', 'Goal', 'Spatial', 'Long']
    methods_order = ['random', 'l2norm', 'attention']

    k09 = [r for r in data if abs(r['k'] - 0.9) < 0.01
           and r['method'] != 'baseline' and r['model'] in models]

    cells = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in k09:
        cells[(r['model'], r['suite'])][r['method']] = r['sr']

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5, 3.8))

    for i, model in enumerate(models):
        for j, suite in enumerate(suites):
            mdata = cells.get((model, suite), {})
            x0, y0 = j - 0.5, i - 0.5

            if not mdata:
                rect = plt.Rectangle((x0, y0), 1, 1,
                                     facecolor='#F0F0F0', edgecolor='white', lw=2)
                ax.add_patch(rect)
                ax.text(j, i, '—', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=14, color='#AAAAAA')
                continue

            best_m = max(mdata, key=mdata.get)
            best_sr = mdata[best_m]
            bg = cell_bg(best_m, best_sr)
            tc = text_col(bg)

            rect = plt.Rectangle((x0, y0), 1, 1,
                                 facecolor=bg, edgecolor='white', lw=2)
            ax.add_patch(rect)

            ax.text(j, i - 0.15, f'{best_sr:.1f}%', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=tc)
            ax.text(j, i + 0.15, METHOD_LABELS[best_m], ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=8, color=tc, alpha=0.85, fontstyle='italic')

            others = {m: s for m, s in mdata.items() if m != best_m}
            if others:
                parts = [f'{METHOD_LABELS[m][:3]}={s:.0f}' for m, s in
                         sorted(others.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])]
                info = '  '.join(parts)
                ax.text(j, i + 0.37, info, ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=5.5, color=tc, alpha=0.6)

    ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(suites) - 0.5)
    ax.set_ylim(len(models) - 0.5, -0.5)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(suites)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(suites, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(models)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(models, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    ax.tick_params(length=0)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)

    legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=METHOD_COLORS[m],
                                     label=METHOD_LABELS[m], alpha=0.8)
                      for m in methods_order]
    legend_patches.append(mpatches.Patch(facecolor='#F0F0F0',
                                         edgecolor='#CCCCCC', label='No data'))
    ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc='upper left',
              bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1.0), fontsize=9, frameon=False)

    ax.set_title('Best SR at $k{=}0.9$: method crossover across models and suites',
                 fontsize=11.5, pad=12)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Figure 2: π0.5 Disruption Curve ─────────────────────────────

def plot_disruption_curve(data, outpath):
    pi_model = 'π0.5'
    pi_data = [r for r in data if r['model'] == pi_model]

    baselines = {}
    for r in pi_data:
        if r['method'] == 'baseline' and r['k'] == 1.0:
            baselines[r['suite']] = r['sr']

    curves = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in pi_data:
        if r['method'] in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            curves[(r['suite'], r['method'])][r['k']] = r['sr']

    for suite, bl in baselines.items():
        for method in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            curves[(suite, method)][1.0] = bl

    suites_plot = ['Object', 'Goal', 'Spatial', 'Long']
    lstyles = {'random': '-', 'l2norm': '--'}
    markers = {'random': 'o', 'l2norm': 's'}

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 5))

    ax.axvspan(0.85, 0.925, alpha=0.07, color='#D32F2F', zorder=0)
    t = ax.text(0.8875, 3, 'cliff zone', ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=8, color='#B71C1C', alpha=0.45, fontstyle='italic')
    t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2.5, foreground='white')])

    for suite in suites_plot:
        base_color = SUITE_COLORS[suite]
        for method in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            key = (suite, method)
            if key not in curves or len(curves[key]) < 2:
                continue
            pts = sorted(curves[key].items())
            ks = [p[0] for p in pts]
            srs = [p[1] for p in pts]
            label = f'{suite} {METHOD_LABELS[method]}'
            ax.plot(ks, srs, lstyles[method], color=base_color,
                    marker=markers[method], markersize=4.5, alpha=0.85,
                    label=label, zorder=3)

    r85 = curves.get(('Object', 'random'), {}).get(0.85)
    l85 = curves.get(('Object', 'l2norm'), {}).get(0.85)
    if r85 is not None and l85 is not None:
        c = SUITE_COLORS['Object']
        ax.annotate(f'Random {r85:.1f}%', xy=(0.85, r85),
                    xytext=(0.72, r85 + 15), fontsize=7.5, color=c,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=0.7), zorder=5)
        ax.annotate(f'L2 {l85:.1f}%', xy=(0.85, l85),
                    xytext=(0.72, l85 - 10), fontsize=7.5, color=c,
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=0.7), zorder=5)

    r09 = curves.get(('Object', 'random'), {}).get(0.9)
    l09 = curves.get(('Object', 'l2norm'), {}).get(0.9)
    if r09 is not None and l09 is not None:
        gap = l09 - r09
        mid_y = (r09 + l09) / 2
        ax.annotate('', xy=(0.9, r09 + 2), xytext=(0.9, l09 - 2),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#555555', lw=1.0), zorder=4)
        txt = ax.text(0.91, mid_y, f'Δ={gap:.0f}pp', fontsize=7,
                      color='#555555', va='center')
        txt.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

    ax.set_xlabel('Keep Ratio ($k$)', fontsize=12)
    ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
    ax.set_xlim(0.25, 1.03)
    ax.set_ylim(-3, 108)
    ax.set_xticks([0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 0.9, 0.925, 0.95, 1.0])
    ax.set_xticklabels(['0.3', '0.5', '0.7', '0.85', '0.9', '0.925', '0.95', '1.0'],
                       fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

    handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
    order = []
    for s in suites_plot:
        for m in ('random', 'l2norm'):
            lbl = f'{s} {METHOD_LABELS[m]}'
            if lbl in labels:
                order.append(labels.index(lbl))
    ax.legend([handles[i] for i in order], [labels[i] for i in order],
              loc='lower left', fontsize=7.5, ncol=2, framealpha=0.92,
              edgecolor='none', columnspacing=1)

    ax.set_title('π0.5 Disruption Curves: Random vs L2-Norm across suites',
                 fontsize=12, pad=10)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Figure 3: CV Diagnostic Scatter ─────────────────────────────

def plot_cv_scatter(data, exps, outpath):
    cv_known = {
        'π0.5':  0.038,
        'OpenVLA':    0.215,
        'SmolVLA':    0.314,
        'X-VLA':      0.025,
        'OpenVLA-OFT': 0.012,
    }

    for eid, exp in exps.items():
        if not isinstance(exp, dict):
            continue
        m = exp.get('metrics') or {}
        cv = m.get('importance_cv')
        if cv is None:
            continue
        if 'pi0' in eid.lower():
            cv_known['π0.5'] = cv
        elif 'smolvla' in eid.lower():
            cv_known['SmolVLA'] = cv

    baselines = {}
    worst_k09 = {}
    all_k09 = defaultdict(dict)

    for r in data:
        if r['suite'] != 'Object':
            continue
        model = r['model']
        if r['method'] == 'baseline' or r['k'] == 1.0:
            baselines[model] = max(baselines.get(model, 0), r['sr'])
        if abs(r['k'] - 0.9) < 0.01 and r['method'] != 'baseline':
            all_k09[model][r['method']] = r['sr']
            if model not in worst_k09 or r['sr'] < worst_k09[model]:
                worst_k09[model] = r['sr']

    bl_fallback = {
        'OpenVLA': 74.0, 'π0.5': 98.2, 'X-VLA': 99.2,
        'SmolVLA': 57.2, 'OpenVLA-OFT': 74.0,
    }
    for m, b in bl_fallback.items():
        baselines.setdefault(m, b)

    points = []
    for model in cv_known:
        if model not in baselines or model not in worst_k09:
            continue
        cv = cv_known[model]
        drop = baselines[model] - worst_k09[model]
        points.append((model, cv, drop))

    if not points:
        print('Warning: no data for CV scatter')
        return

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.5))

    ax.axhspan(0, 15, alpha=0.04, color='#4CAF50', zorder=0)
    ax.axhspan(50, 100, alpha=0.04, color='#F44336', zorder=0)
    ax.text(0.01, 7, 'robust', fontsize=8, color='#66BB6A', alpha=0.5,
            fontstyle='italic', va='center')
    ax.text(0.01, 75, 'fragile', fontsize=8, color='#EF5350', alpha=0.5,
            fontstyle='italic', va='center')

    offsets = {
        'π0.5': (10, -14), 'OpenVLA': (10, 8), 'X-VLA': (10, 8),
        'SmolVLA': (-15, 10), 'OpenVLA-OFT': (-15, -15),
    }

    for model, cv, drop in points:
        color = MODEL_COLORS.get(model, '#333333')
        ax.scatter(cv, drop, c=color, s=140, zorder=4,
                   edgecolors='white', linewidths=1.5)
        ox, oy = offsets.get(model, (10, 8))
        arrow = dict(arrowstyle='-', color='gray', lw=0.4) if abs(ox) > 15 or abs(oy) > 15 else None
        ax.annotate(model, (cv, drop), xytext=(ox, oy),
                    textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9.5, color=color,
                    fontweight='bold', arrowprops=arrow)

    ax.set_xlabel('Importance Score CV (coefficient of variation)', fontsize=11)
    ax.set_ylabel('Max SR Drop at $k{=}0.9$ (pp)', fontsize=11)
    ax.set_title('Token Importance CV vs Pruning Sensitivity', fontsize=12, pad=10)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.12, zorder=0)

    cv_vals = [p[1] for p in points]
    drop_vals = [p[2] for p in points]
    ax.set_xlim(-0.02, max(cv_vals) + 0.06)
    ax.set_ylim(min(-5, min(drop_vals) - 5), max(drop_vals) + 12)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')


# ── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    print('Loading registry...')
    exps = load_registry()
    data = build_data(exps)
    n_success = sum(1 for e in exps.values() if e.get('conclusion') == 'success')
    print(f'Parsed {len(data)} unique data points from {n_success} successful experiments')

    plot_crossover_heatmap(data, OUTPUT_DIR / 'crossover_heatmap.pdf')
    plot_disruption_curve(data, OUTPUT_DIR / 'disruption_curve.pdf')
    plot_cv_scatter(data, exps, OUTPUT_DIR / 'cv_scatter.pdf')

    print('\nAll figures saved to:', OUTPUT_DIR)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
